project_name: WORKNOON AI Customer Support Refund System

brand_identity.logo_concept: Deep purple circular icon with minimalist white 'W'

hierarchy.hero_title: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white leading-tight
hierarchy.section_heading: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
hierarchy.body: text-sm sm:text-base font-normal text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed
hierarchy.meta_label: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

navigation_header.style: Glassmorphism header with logo ('W' in deep purple circle), tab switch (Customer Refund Portal vs Admin Support Portal), connection status, and quick policy guide drawer trigger.

customer_view.layout: Two-column grid on desktop (12 columns: 5 cols lookup & order context + policy card, 7 cols main refund request form & live AI evaluation result).
features: Customer ID / Email quick lookup with realistic dummy suggestions (e.g. 'c_101 / john@worknoon.com', 'c_102 / sarah@techcorp.com')
Interactive Order Card selector displaying purchased subscription / job posting packages with amounts and order dates
Reason selector dropdown + detailed text area with character counter
Refund amount specification (Full vs Partial with custom amount input)
Dynamic Submit CTA with animated AI evaluation state (simulated neural processing animation)

Rich AI Decision Result Card featuring: Decision Badge (Approved/Denied/Escalated), Confidence Score Radial/Progress bar, Transparent Reasoning Summary, Policy Rules Matched, and Actionable Next Steps

admin_view.layout: Password-protected security layer with passcode modal/card -> High-density analytical table layout with stats bar at the top.
features: KPI Stats Bar: Total Requests, Approval Rate, Escalations Pending, Avg AI Confidence
Decision Filter Pills: All, Approved, Denied, Escalated with count badges
Search & Sortable Data Table: Customer Name, Order ID, Requested Amount, Decision, Confidence %, AI Reason preview, Timestamp
Request Detail Drawer / Modal: Complete Audit Trail breakdown, Raw JSON policy trace, Manual Override Controls (Approve/Deny/Escalate override with agent notes)
Refund Policy Configuration Tab / Drawer: View and edit active threshold rules (e.g. 14-day window, max partial amount limit)

testability_guidelines.rule: Every single interactive element, form input, filter pill, modal, and critical display container MUST contain explicit data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject Google Fonts link in public/index.html or index.css for Plus Jakarta Sans & JetBrains Mono.
Ensure dark/light mode toggle works seamlessly with crisp contrast across both views.
Implement realistic mock AI evaluation with loading animation (simulated evaluation delay 1.2s) when submitting customer requests.
Provide seed mock data in backend/frontend with at least 8 varied refund requests (mix of Approved, Denied, Escalated with detailed AI reasoning and audit steps).
Keep background overlays non-transparent (use solid or backdrop-blur-xl with border) to avoid unreadable text overlay errors.
Always maintain strict data-testid compliance on all form fields, buttons, and status displays for test runners.
